words.definition: n. 百科全书；（喻）学识渊博的人

examples.en: The first edition of the encyclopedia appeared in the eighteenth century.
examples.zh: 这部百科全书的第一版问世于十八世纪。

examples.en: My grandfather is a walking encyclopedia of local history.
examples.zh: 我祖父是一部当地历史的活字典。

words.usage: 可数名词，an encyclopedia of 本义与比喻均可用；a walking encyclopedia 喻「活字典」。派生：encyclopedic adj. 百科式的、渊博的，阅读中常见其比喻用法。
collocations: consult an encyclopedia 查阅百科全书
words.mnemonic: en+cyclo(全环)+ped(知识)+ia → 收全知识的书

words.definition: n. 对话；（国家、团体间的）磋商，交换意见

examples.en: The two governments resumed dialogue after months of tension.
examples.zh: 数月紧张之后，两国政府恢复了对话。

examples.en: The novel is famous for its vivid dialogue and subtle humor.
examples.zh: 这部小说以生动的对话和含蓄的幽默著称。

words.usage: 美式常拼作 dialog；抽象用法 dialogue between A and B 表双方磋商，政治、外交文本高频。相关词 monologue n. 独白；派生 dialogic adj. 对话式的。
collocations: dialogue between states 国家间磋商
words.mnemonic: dia(相对)+log(说) → 两人对说 → 对话

words.definition: n. 可卡因，古柯碱

examples.en: Customs officers seized a shipment of cocaine hidden in furniture.
examples.zh: 海关人员查获了一批藏在家具里的可卡因。

examples.en: He was arrested for trafficking in cocaine and sentenced to ten years.
examples.zh: 他因贩卖可卡因被捕，被判十年监禁。

words.usage: 不可数名词，禁毒、法律语境高频；常用搭配 traffic in cocaine 贩毒、seize cocaine 缴获毒品。来源词 coca n. 古柯；crack cocaine 指强效快克可卡因。
collocations: traffic in cocaine 贩卖可卡因
words.mnemonic: coca(古柯叶)+ine(生物碱) → 音译「可卡因」

words.definition: n. 露水；（泪、汗等的）细珠

examples.en: The grass was still wet with dew when we set out.
examples.zh: 我们出发时草上的露水未干。

examples.en: Morning dew glittered on the spider webs along the path.
examples.zh: 晨露在路旁的蜘蛛网上闪闪发光。

words.usage: 不可数名词，晨露；be wet with dew 被露水打湿；dew point 露点为气象术语。派生：dewy adj. 带露的，引申「纯真的」。注意与同音词 due 区分。
collocations: be wet with dew 沾满露水
words.mnemonic: 谐音「丢」→ 露珠丢在草尖上；due 才是「到期」

words.definition: n. 小屋，棚屋（简陋的）

examples.en: The hikers sheltered from the storm in a wooden hut.
examples.zh: 徒步者在一间小木屋里躲避暴风雨。

examples.en: The fishermen built a hut near the shore to store their nets.
examples.zh: 渔民在岸边搭了间棚屋存放渔网。

words.usage: 可数名词，指简陋的小屋、棚屋，多用于登山、旅行、灾区语境；语气比 house、cottage 简陋破旧。搭配 shelter in a hut 在小屋暂避风雨。
collocations: shelter in a hut 在小屋躲避
words.mnemonic: 谐音「哈特」小屋；cut 砍木搭成 hut

words.definition: n. 松树，松木；vi. 憔悴，消瘦；渴望

examples.en: The hillside is covered with pine forests that date back centuries.
examples.zh: 山坡上覆盖着有数百年历史的松林。

examples.en: Locked in the city, he pined for the mountains of his childhood.
examples.zh: 困在城市里，他渴望着童年的群山。

words.usage: 名词义「松树、松木」，pine forest 松林；考研重点是动词义：pine for sth 渴望某物，pine away 因忧伤而日渐消瘦。派生：pineapple n. 菠萝。
words.mnemonic: pine away 思念到瘦成松针；松树本义最常用

words.definition: n. 地窖，酒窖；（美）地下室

examples.en: The farmer stores his apples in a cool cellar over winter.
examples.zh: 农民把苹果存放在凉爽的地窖里过冬。

examples.en: Beneath the house lies a wine cellar built two centuries ago.
examples.zh: 房子下面有一座建于两百年前的酒窖。

words.usage: 可数名词，指储酒的地窖，泛指地下储藏室；keep wine in the cellar 窖藏葡萄酒。英式 cellar 偏储藏功能，basement 多指可住人的地下室。
collocations: damp cellar 潮湿的地下室
words.mnemonic: cell(小室)+ar → 地下小室 → 酒窖

words.definition: n. 举办场所，会场；（律）审判地

examples.en: The stadium was chosen as the venue for the closing ceremony.
examples.zh: 该体育场被选为闭幕式的举办场地。

examples.en: Organizers changed the venue because of the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 由于大雨，主办方更换了活动地点。

words.usage: 可数名词，正式用词，指活动、比赛的举办场地，venue for sth；法律语境 change the venue 表变更审判地点。新闻、体育报道高频词。
collocations: venue for the conference 会议场地
change the venue 更换场地
words.mnemonic: ven(来)+ue → 大家「来」的地方 → 会场

words.definition: n. 梳子；vt. 梳理；彻底搜查

examples.en: She combed her hair quickly before the interview.
examples.zh: 面试前她迅速梳了梳头发。

examples.en: Police combed the area for clues but found nothing.
examples.zh: 警方彻底搜查了该地区寻找线索，却一无所获。

words.usage: 名词梳子；动词「彻底搜查」搭配 comb an area for clues、comb through documents 仔细翻查文件。注意词尾 b 不发音，听写易错。
collocations: comb through files 彻查文件
words.mnemonic: tomb、bomb、comb：词尾 b 全都不发音

words.definition: n. 裤子，长裤（复数名词）

examples.en: He bought a pair of grey trousers for the job interview.
examples.zh: 他为求职面试买了一条灰色西裤。

examples.en: My old trousers are worn out, so I need a new pair.
examples.zh: 我的旧裤子穿破了，需要买条新的。

words.usage: 复数名词，永远以复数形式出现，谓语动词用复数；「一条裤子」须说 a pair of trousers。同类复数名词还有 jeans、shorts、scissors、glasses，写作须留意。
collocations: a pair of trousers 一条裤子
words.mnemonic: 成双名词像 scissors；一条 = a pair of trousers

words.definition: n. 论述，论文；话语，语篇；vi. 讲述

examples.en: The article analyzes how media discourse shapes public attitudes.
examples.zh: 这篇文章分析媒体话语如何塑造公众态度。

examples.en: In his discourse on education, the professor questioned exam-oriented learning.
examples.zh: 在关于教育的论述中，教授质疑了应试学习。

words.usage: 名词学术语境高频，指「话语、语篇」，如 academic discourse 学术话语；亦指长篇论述，a discourse on sth。派生：discursive adj. 散漫的、离题的。
collocations: a discourse on politics 政治论述
words.mnemonic: dis(各处)+course(跑) → 思路展开 → 论述、语篇

words.definition: n. 宇航员，航天员

examples.en: The astronaut spent six months conducting experiments in space.
examples.zh: 这名宇航员花了六个月在太空做实验。

examples.en: She trained for ten years before becoming an astronaut.
examples.zh: 她训练了十年才成为宇航员。

words.usage: 可数名词，美国宇航员称 astronaut，俄国称 cosmonaut，中国航天员亦译 taikonaut。派生：astronautics n. 航天学；astronomer n. 天文学家，两词勿混。
collocations: train as an astronaut 受训成为宇航员
words.mnemonic: astro(星)+naut(航行) → 星际航行者 → 宇航员

words.definition: n. 丰富，充足；adv. 十分，相当

examples.en: There is plenty of evidence that exercise improves memory.
examples.zh: 有大量证据表明锻炼能改善记忆。

examples.en: Don't worry about tickets; there are plenty of seats left.
examples.zh: 别担心票，还剩很多座位呢。

words.usage: plenty of 后接不可数名词或可数名词复数，语气比 many、much 口语化；不用于否定句和疑问句，否定要改用 much、many。派生：plentiful adj. 充足的。
collocations: plenty of time 充足的时间
plenty of room 足够的空间
words.mnemonic: plenty of「有的是」；否定句记得换 much、many

words.definition: n. 尼龙；尼龙长袜（nylons）

examples.en: The tent is made of lightweight nylon that dries quickly.
examples.zh: 帐篷由速干的轻质尼龙制成。

examples.en: Nylon stockings became fashionable shortly after the war.
examples.zh: 战后不久尼龙长袜便流行起来。

words.usage: 物质名词不可数；复数 nylons 特指尼龙长袜。科技、生活阅读常见 nylon rope、nylon fabric。同类织物词：polyester 涤纶、rayon 人造丝、cotton 棉。
words.mnemonic: 音译「尼龙」：New York＋London 首尾拼成

words.definition: n. 遗憾，可惜；同情；vt. 怜悯

examples.en: It is a pity that the museum closed before we arrived.
examples.zh: 真遗憾，我们到之前博物馆就闭馆了。

examples.en: She felt pity for the refugees and donated her savings.
examples.zh: 她同情难民，捐出了自己的积蓄。

words.usage: 句型 It is a pity that… 真遗憾；What a pity! 多可惜；have pity on sb 同情某人。派生：pitiful adj. 可怜的；pitiless adj. 无情的。
collocations: out of pity 出于同情
feel pity for sb 同情某人
words.mnemonic: 谐音「劈替」→ 替人难受 → 同情、遗憾

words.definition: adv. 相当，颇；宁愿；更确切地说

examples.en: He would rather work overtime than miss the deadline.
examples.zh: 他宁愿加班也不愿错过截止日期。

examples.en: The result was rather disappointing, contrary to expectations.
examples.zh: 与预期相反，结果相当令人失望。

words.usage: 三大句型考点：would rather do sth than do sth 宁愿…而不…；rather than 而非；or rather 更确切地说。修饰形容词表「相当」，语气强于 fairly。
words.mnemonic: would rather A than B：宁愿 A 也不 B

words.definition: n. 婚礼；结合，联姻

examples.en: The whole village was invited to their wedding ceremony.
examples.zh: 全村人都受邀参加他们的婚礼。

examples.en: They flew to Paris to attend their daughter's wedding.
examples.zh: 他们飞往巴黎参加女儿的婚礼。

words.usage: 指婚礼这一「仪式庆典」，与 marriage 表婚姻状态相对。搭配 wedding ceremony 婚礼、wedding anniversary 结婚纪念日。派生：wed v. 娶，嫁；wedded adj. 已婚的。
collocations: attend a wedding 参加婚礼
words.mnemonic: wed(娶嫁)+ding → 婚礼；weeding 是除草

words.definition: n. （日、月）食；黯然失色；vt. 使黯然失色，超过

examples.en: Thousands gathered to watch the total solar eclipse.
examples.zh: 数千人聚集观看日全食。

examples.en: Her early success was eclipsed by that of her rival.
examples.zh: 她早期的成功被对手的光芒盖过了。

words.usage: solar eclipse 日食、lunar eclipse 月食；动词考点「使黯然失色」，be eclipsed by 被盖过、被超越，比喻用法为阅读高频。in eclipse 指失势、黯淡。
collocations: eclipse sb's fame 使某人声名失色
words.mnemonic: ec(出)+lipse(离) → 光被遮走 → 日食；使失色

words.definition: n. （大学或高中的）二年级学生

examples.en: As a sophomore, she chose economics as her major.
examples.zh: 大二时她选了经济学作为专业。

examples.en: The sophomore published his first paper in a leading journal.
examples.zh: 这名大二学生在顶级期刊上发表了第一篇论文。

words.usage: 美式学制词：freshman 大一、sophomore 大二、junior 大三、senior 大四，宜系列记忆。派生：sophomoric adj. 幼稚自负的。英式多说 second-year student。
collocations: college sophomore 大学二年级学生
sophomore slump 二年级低谷期
words.mnemonic: sopho(聪明)+more(更) → 自觉更聪明的大二生

words.definition: n. 加仑（液量单位）

examples.en: The truck consumes a gallon of diesel every fifteen miles.
examples.zh: 这辆卡车每十五英里耗一加仑柴油。

examples.en: Gasoline is sold by the gallon in the United States.
examples.zh: 在美国，汽油按加仑出售。

words.usage: 液量单位，美制一加仑约三点八升，英制约四点五升，阅读换算须留意；by the gallon 按加仑计；gallons of water 喻「大量的水」。
collocations: a gallon of gasoline 一加仑汽油
gallons of water 大量的水
sell by the gallon 按加仑出售
words.mnemonic: 音译「加仑」；谐音「该轮」→ 该轮到加油了
